description: Returns the documentation sections that answer your question, taken from the package at a specific version (its published files and its repo at the release tag) and the project site. Without a version it documents the newest version with no known advisories. With a vulnerable version it starts with a SECURITY NOTICE and documents the safe version on the same release line, so the code you write keeps working after the upgrade.

ecosystem.description: Registry, when the id does not say it or says the wrong one; overrides the id.

libraryId.description: Id from find-library, e.g. "npm:next" or "npm:next@15.1.0". A GitHub repo ("/vercel/next.js") also works. Or pass name and ecosystem instead.

name.description: Package name with ecosystem, as check-package takes them, instead of libraryId.

packageName.description: Registry package name, when it differs from the id; overrides the id.

query.description: The question or task, e.g. "protect routes with middleware". Without it: setup and main API.

tokens.description: Approximate size of the answer in tokens (default 2500; raise it only when the answer was cut short).

version.description: Version the project uses or pins, if any. Overrides the one in libraryId.

name: get-docs
title: Documentation for the version you will use (security-checked)
